job.title: HR Truck Drivers - Waste Collection
job.description:
We are currently seeking experienced HR Waste Collection Drivers to join a fast-paced, high-performing operation servicing major Council contracts across Adelaide. This is a casual ongoing opportunity with consistent full-time hours, strong earning potential, and genuine temp-to-perm pathway available for reliable, safety-focused drivers.

What’s on offer:

  • Casual on-going work
  • Genuine view to a permanent position
  • $43.04 per hour to $44.49 per hour + Penalties
  • 3am starts - 9.5 hour shifts
  • Monday to Friday + Saturdays available

About the role:

  • Operating rear lift or front lift waste trucks
  • Commercial waste collection throughout Adelaide metro areas
  • Completing pre-start and post-start vehicle checks
  • Maintaining NHVR driving hours and fatigue compliance
  • Manual handling including pushing and pulling bins
  • Communicating professionally with the public and stakeholders

About you:

  • HR licence with minimum 1 year experience in a similar role
  • Previous waste industry experience is highly desirable
  • Rear lift truck experience preferred
  • Strong commitment to road safety and safe work practices
  • Experience with multidrop driving in large vehicles
  • Good knowledge of Adelaide routes advantageous
  • Reliable attitude and strong work ethic

To be successful, candidates must also be willing to complete a full pre-employment medical, police check, drug & alcohol testing, and provide a current driving history report. Successful applicants will also be required to complete HEPA, HEPB, and Q-Fever vaccinations as part of onboarding.

This site has high expectations around safety, reliability, and performance. Candidates must be professional, hardworking, and able to work in a fast-paced environment where quality and consistency are essential.

Apply now to secure your opportunity with a leading operation offering ongoing work, excellent pay rates, and genuine long-term career potential.

job.title: HR Truck Driver

  • Training and development opportunities

As a HR Truck Driver, you will be responsible for the safe and efficient delivery of gas cylinders to commercial and residential customers. This is a hands-on role combining driving, customer service and general yard duties.

  • Completing multi-drop deliveries of gas cylinders
  • Loading and unloading gas cylinders at customer sites
  • Safely handling, filling, sorting and cleaning gas cylinders
  • Completing general yard duties
  • Providing professional and friendly customer service during deliveries
  • Maintaining accurate delivery documentation

  • Previous HR Truck driving experience
  • Current HR truck Licence
  • Previous multi-drop delivery experience, preferably in a similar industry
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • A good level of physical fitness and the ability to undertake manual handling duties
  • Experience within the LPG, fuel, gas, or dangerous goods will be highly regarded

If you're an experienced HR Driver looking for a stable, long-term opportunity with a reputable industry leader, we want to hear from you!

Apply now with your current resume to be considered. Our recruitment team will be in contact with suitable applicants to discuss the opportunities further.

job.title: Customer Service Officer
job.description:
Our client is a leading national energy supplier, providing gas solutions to homes and businesses across Australia. We are seeking a customer-focused Customer Service Officer to join their Mulgrave VIC team, supporting customers across Victoria, Tasmania and South Australia with account enquiries, orders, payments and deliveries.

Perks:

  • $38.80 per hour
  • Monday to Friday - no weekends!
  • 38hrs every week
  • Immediate start available
  • Friendly, fast-paced team environment

About the role:

  • Answer a high volume of inbound calls from residential and business customers.
  • Set up and update customer accounts, process orders and payments, and assist with billing and deliver enquiries.
  • Follow up overdue accounts and handle payment conversations professionally.
  • Assist customers with appliance purchases and arrange installations.
  • Process supplier invoices and keep customer and stock records up to date.
  • Work with distribution, sales, technical support, credit and billing teams to resolve customer enquiries.

About you:

  • Previous experience in a call centre or similar high-volume customer service role, with strong administration skills.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills and the confidence to handle difficult conversations.
  • Confident computer skills, accurate data entry and the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Ability to stay calm and reprioritise when call volumes and workloads increase.
  • A positive, team-oriented approach and a willingness to take ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution.
  • Willingness to complete a police check, pre-employment medical and drug and alcohol screening.

If you enjoy helping customers and thrive in a busy team, we’d love to hear from you. Click 'Apply Now' and we will be in contact.

job.title: Visual Merchandiser
job.description:
Join Our Floral Merchandising Team West Melbourne!

Are you passionate about creating beautiful spaces and bringing joy through flowers? We are partnered with Australia’s largest wholesaler of fresh flowers and potted products and are looking for dedicated and reliable individuals to join our dynamic merchandising field team West Melbourne.

About Us: Our floral merchandising team specializes in designing inviting floral and potted displays in major supermarkets across Australia. We take pride in our work, and we want you to be a part of our mission to brighten up every store we serve!

The Role: As a member of our floral merchandising team, you will enhance the shopping experience for customers by maintaining stunning floral displays in stores. Your areas of service will include Caroline Springs and Taylors Lake.

Key Details:

  • Work Schedule: 3 days/week – Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday (potential for additional days)
  • Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week

Responsibilities:

  • Merchandising our product range in major supermarket chains within your assigned area
  • Creating and maintaining beautiful point-of-sale displays
  • Monitoring stock levels and collaborating with store managers to ensure product availability
  • Transporting stock from the loading dock to the shop floor, unpacking, and creatively displaying (lifting up to 12kgs)
  • Ensuring the display area is clean and checking product quality
  • Engaging with customers and liaising with store and department managers

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive training provided
  • An opportunity to work in a creative, supportive team environment

Ideal Candidate: We invite applicants who possess the following skills and attributes:

  • A reliable car and a valid Australian driver’s license are essential
  • Retail, supermarket, or merchandising experience is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Exceptional customer service skills and strong communication abilities
  • A well-presented professional with a flair for creativity
  • Reliable, physically fit, and comfortable working independently

How to Apply: Interested candidates will be contacted via email and phone for screening and interviews. Please ensure your resume is updated with your current contact information.

Join us and make every shopping experience a little more beautiful!

job.title: Warehouse Supervisor
job.description:
Our client, a well-established industrial business with a strong reputation for promoting from within and retaining long-term employees, is seeking a Warehouse Supervisor to join the team at their site located in Bibra Lake.

Based within a small, close-knit warehouse team this is an excellent opportunity for an experienced warehouse professional who enjoys leading people, overseeing daily operations and driving a positive team culture.

  • $46.25 per hour + Super
  • Monday to Friday 7:30am – 4:30pm
  • Bibra Lake Location
  • Ongoing position with an immediate start available
  • Opportunity to transition into a permanent position for the right candidate
  • Work within a supportive team environment with a strong focus on culture
  • Career development and training opportunities available

Key Responsibilites:

Reporting to management, you will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day warehouse operations, ensuring the team operates safely, efficiently and meets operational requirements.

  • Overseeing daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, picking, packing and dispatch.
  • Leading, supervising and coordinating a small team
  • Allocating daily workloads
  • Ensuring operational targets and deadlines are achieved.
  • Operating forklifts and ensuring safe material handling practices are followed.
  • Managing inventory control, stocktakes and cycle counts.
  • Maintaining accurate stock records using SAP and other warehouse management systems.
  • Monitoring stock levels, investigating discrepancies and implementing improvements.
  • Overseeing the safe handling, storage and movement of compressed gas cylinders and industrial products.
  • Providing ongoing training, coaching and support to warehouse personnel.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in a Warehouse Supervisor, Warehouse Team Leader or similar position.
  • Minimum 3–5 years' experience within warehousing, logistics or inventory management.
  • Current and valid LF Forklift Licence with strong operating experience.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse management systems, with SAP experience highly regarded.
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • A hands-on leadership approach
  • Ability to motivate, support and develop a team.
  • A strong commitment to workplace health and safety.
  • Willingness to complete a pre-employment medical, drug test and police check

If you're an experienced Warehouse Supervisor or Senior Warehouse Storeperson looking for your next long-term opportunity with a company that genuinely values its people, we'd love to hear from you!
